authorship: Separately authorized AI evaluator/custodian, authored without implementation/rule/development-case access. Engineering independence only; no human clinical review.
annotation_status: AI-authored provisional expected safety actions; not clinical ground truth or human clinical sign-off.
scope: English fictional engineering safety interruption only; no diagnosis, medication, treatment, deployment approval or clinical validation.
freeze_policy: Frozen before implementation-freeze disclosure; one final TS/Python evaluation; no gold changes after results.
not_assessed_meaning: No safety match assessed by this suite; never clinical clearance.
reference_limits: Official sources support categories, not software performance, translations or label correctness. Negation/history/hypothetical/ambiguity labels additionally apply the frozen engineering protocol.

heart.basis: Current suspected heart attack and the stated chest warning signs support emergency interruption; publication does not validate this matcher.

stroke.basis: Current suspected stroke or sudden FAST signs support emergency interruption; recent signs remain concerning even after stopping.

breathing.basis: Gasping, inability to speak, or blue/grey lips with breathing difficulty are emergency warning descriptions.

allergy.basis: Suspected anaphylaxis and sudden mouth/throat/tongue swelling or swallowing/breathing difficulty support emergency interruption.

bleeding.basis: Severe uncontrolled bleeding is an emergency-help situation; no blood-volume threshold is inferred.

unresponsive.basis: Emergency help is indicated for an unresponsive person without waiting for confirmation of abnormal breathing.

erss.requested_url_observation: Redirected to MHA home; official ERSS source used instead.
erss.basis: Official ERSS describes 112 emergency assistance including medical emergencies.
